story.title: Who We Are
story.body: Samara from Home was born during the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, when we all had to stay healthy at home. It started from my desire to give the best nutrition for my toddler and my family. That's why Samara sauces are non-MSG and vegan-friendly, made only from the finest natural ingredients. Over time, Samara's sauces have been loved by many who want to create cafe-style dishes at home. Today, Samara from Home has grown into various cooking sauce variants that can be shipped across Indonesia and even brought abroad.

highlights.title: Carbonara & Cheese
highlights.body: Saus creamy berbasis telur, keju, dan susu kaya nutrisi tanpa pengawet untuk pasta dan hidangan keluarga.

highlights.title: Italian Pesto & Chimichurri
highlights.body: Bestseller saus artisan daun basil segar, kacang mete, dan rempah untuk steak, roti panggang, dan pasta.

highlights.title: Rawon Sauce Paste
highlights.body: Cooking paste berbasis kluwek otentik dan rempah aromatik Nusantara untuk rawon, sup, dan nasi goreng.

highlights.title: Sambal Kecombrang & Chili Padi
highlights.body: Sambal aromatik bunga kecombrang dan cabai rawit pedas segar dengan minyak kelapa alami.
